card.name: Linking words before buprenorphine or naltrexone
card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, with, in, or, a comma) or the start of a drug name, right before buprenorphine, buprenorphine/naloxone or naltrexone in opioid addiction treatment text.

modes.label: Link before the next drug
modes.description: A preposition or comma just before buprenorphine or naltrexone, often in switching or treatment wording.

modes.description: The first letter or piece of buprenorphine or naltrexone, as the name begins.
